subject: Re: Dedicated sizing check + short hold request for Eidos Systems
messages:
From: Patricia Gomez <patricia.gomez@eidos.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Eidos Systems - Ops Team <ops@eidos.ai>
Date: 2027-05-02T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Dedicated sizing ask and tentative MOA

Jonas —

Thanks again for the presence on yesterday's executive call. We're moving fast on the POC-to-dedicated conversion and need a short internal check from your side to confirm whether Redwood can support our initial steady-state footprint. High-level ask: can you confirm availability for ~24 A100-class GPUs (or equivalent quantized instances) with a two-week soft hold while procurement finishes the MOA?

Key constraints from our side:
- Start window: target July 1, 2027 (flex +/- 2 weeks)
- Preferred region: us-east (low-latency to our infra)
- Data residency: no additional constraints beyond usual (we'll sign the MOA)

I've attached the MOA draft and a one-page expected topology. Happy to jump on a quick call if a capacity scan requires more detail.

Patricia
VP Product, Eidos Systems
patricia.gomez@eidos.ai

Attachment: eidos_moa_draft.pdf

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-02T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Dedicated sizing ask and tentative MOA

Karthik / Mina — forwarding Eidos' note. Short internal check: can we safely commit a 14-day soft hold on ~24 A100-equivalent units for the July 1 start window in us-east? If inventory is tight we should propose an equivalent mix (e.g., 8xH100-sim + 16xA10x to match throughput) and be explicit about degraded tail latency.

Proposed internal steps:
1) Ops: snapshot current committed vs free capacity in us-east for July 1-21
2) Runtime/Servicing: confirm whether we need to reserve NVMe-backed nodes for checkpointing and how that affects placement
3) Sales: confirm MOA routing and whether Eidos expects hard SLA at start (they said steady-state)

Can you run the snapshot and advise ETA? I'm going to block a 30-min slot for a quick readout after you have numbers.

-JW

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-02T13:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Dedicated sizing ask and tentative MOA

Jonas / Mina —

Ran the capacity snapshot for us-east (see attached CSV). Short summary:
- Calendar window: 2027-07-01 to 2027-07-21
- Committed (reserved e.g., Dedicated & Reserved pools): 312 A100-equivalent GPUs
- Projected baseline utilization (existing customers + runway): 276 A100-equivalent GPUs
- Uncommitted free capacity in region: ~36 A100-equivalent GPUs (buffer ~20% for scheduling slack)

Conclusion: we can place a 14-day soft hold for 24 A100-equivalents today without displacing committed customers, but margin is narrow if any other large commit arrives. Two operational notes:
- If Eidos requires strict 99th-percentile SLA on <150ms tail, we should mix in H100-backed instances for the most latency-sensitive shards (cost increase ~12%).
- NVMe checkpoint/backing will consume node slots; if Eidos plans heavy checkpointing we should allocate an additional 4 GPU-equivalents for staging.

I can submit a soft-hold request to Capacity Ops (INF-2891) and flag as "deal-provisional". Need approval from Marissa for any cross-customer reallocation.

Attachment: fleet_snapshot_20270501.csv

Karthik
Head of Capacity & Provisioning

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Patricia Gomez <patricia.gomez@eidos.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-03T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated sizing ask and tentative MOA

Patricia —

Thanks for the MOA and context. Short summary from our side after an internal scan:
- We can place a 14-day soft hold for 24 A100-equivalent GPUs in us-east for the July 1 window.
- If you want strict sub-150ms 99th-percentile SLAs we recommend a mixed profile; we can include a recommended sizing table in the MOA.
- Hold will be labeled "deal-provisional: EIDOS-2027-34"; it does not affect existing committed customers but will be released if an urgent contractual commit occurs.

Next steps:
1) Eidos signs the MOA draft (Patricia — flag any legal asks and we can route fast)
2) Sales (Marissa) will confirm the hold activation once procurement confirms timeline
3) Ops (Karthik) will create the hold ticket and post confirmation (INF-2891)

I've attached the internal confirmation token for your tracking. We'll keep you posted if any capacity pressure appears. If helpful we can schedule a 20-min call tomorrow to walk the sizing table.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.ai | +1 (555) 732-0199
